canonical_statement: CAP-IT tested whether lower-dose amoxicillin was noninferior to higher-dose amoxicillin and whether 3-day treatment was noninferior to 7-day treatment for pediatric community-acquired pneumonia.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: To determine whether lower-dose amoxicillin is noninferior to higher dose and whether 3-day treatment is noninferior to 7 days.

canonical_statement: CAP-IT was a multicenter, randomized, blinded, placebo-controlled, 2×2 factorial noninferiority trial conducted at 28 hospitals in the UK and 1 in Ireland.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This was a multicenter, randomized, blinded, placebo-controlled, 2 × 2 factorial, noninferiority trial conducted in 28 hospitals in the UK and 1 in Ireland.

canonical_statement: Eligible children were older than 6 months, weighed 6-24 kg, had clinically diagnosed CAP, and were planned for amoxicillin monotherapy at discharge.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Children were eligible if they were older than 6 months of age, weighed 6 to 24 kg, were clinically diagnosed with CAP, and treatment with amoxicillin monotherapy on discharge ... was planned.

canonical_statement: Key exclusions included >48 hours of uninterrupted prior beta-lactam treatment, any prior non-beta-lactam treatment, severe chronic disease, amoxicillin contraindication/allergy, complicated pneumonia, or bilateral wheezing without focal chest signs.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Exclusion criteria were (1) uninterrupted prior β-lactam antibiotic treatment for more than 48 hours or any prior non-β-lactam treatment; (2) severe underlying chronic disease; (3) any contraindications to amoxicillin, including allergy; (4) complicated pneumonia ...; or (5) bilateral wheezing without focal chest signs.

canonical_statement: Randomization used computer-generated blocks of 8, simultaneous 1:1 allocation to each factorial randomization, and stratification by site and prior in-hospital nontrial antibiotic exposure.

canonical_statement: Dose blinding used independently rebottled amoxicillin brands with identical administered volumes by weight band; duration blinding used active drug or matching placebo on days 4-7.

canonical_statement: The noninferiority margin was an 8-percentage-point risk difference assessed against a 1-sided 95% CI; 800 participants were estimated to provide 90% power assuming a 15% re-treatment rate, 15% loss to follow-up, and no dose-duration interaction.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The noninferiority margin was defined as a risk difference of 8% assessed against a 1-sided 95% CI ... the sample size of 800 participants was estimated to achieve 90% power.

canonical_statement: The primary analysis included participants who received trial drug and analyzed them according to randomized group; day-28 cumulative incidence used Kaplan-Meier methods accounting for loss to follow-up.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The primary analysis included only participants who received the trial drug, and patients were analyzed in the groups to which they were randomized. The proportion ... was obtained from the cumulative incidence at day 28 as estimated by Kaplan-Meier methods accounting for loss to follow-up.

canonical_statement: Secondary endpoint analyses were not adjusted for multiple comparisons and were designated exploratory because of type I error risk.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Analyses of secondary end points were not adjusted for multiple comparisons. Because of the potential for type 1 error due to multiple comparisons, findings for secondary end points and analyses should be interpreted as exploratory.

canonical_statement: During the internal pilot, the noninferiority margin was changed from 4% to 8% after the observed event rate was substantially higher than originally assumed; the supplement states the 8% choice was arbitrary but conservative relative to contemporaneous guidance.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At the time it was acknowledged that the selection of an 8% non-inferiority margin was arbitrary but conservative considering guidance available at the time for antibiotic trials using similar clinical endpoints.
